findings.what: Leave check is outside the booking transaction and recordLeave takes no lock; a booking committed right after the leave UPDATE stays 'booked' on a leave day and is missing from the affected list
Waitlist offer holds are protected only by a read check with no DB constraint; a concurrent reassign or booking can take a held slot (offer acceptance then fails cleanly)
Slots freed by patient reschedule or reassignment of a booked appointment are not offered to the waitlist
Expiry sweep runs every 5 minutes, so an offer can take up to ~35 min to pass to the next patient unless the expired link is opened
freeDoctorsAt runs several queries per affected appointment x doctor pair
